glossary.blinded: Cannot see. Disadvantage on attack rolls, advantage for attackers.
glossary.charmed: Cannot attack the charm source. Source has advantage on social checks.
glossary.deafened: Cannot hear. Automatically fails checks requiring hearing.
glossary.frightened: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while source of fear is visible.
glossary.grappled: Speed reduced to 0. Ends if the grappler is incapacitated.
glossary.invisible: Cannot be seen without magic. Advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage for attackers.
glossary.paralyzed: Incapacitated. Fails STR and DEX saves. Melee hits within 5 ft are critical.
glossary.petrified: Turned to stone. Incapacitated, resistance to all damage.
glossary.poisoned: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
glossary.prone: Can only crawl. Disadvantage on attack rolls. Melee: advantage, ranged: disadvantage.
glossary.restrained: Speed 0. Disadvantage on attack rolls and DEX saves. Attackers have advantage.
glossary.stunned: Incapacitated, cannot move. Fails STR and DEX saves. Attackers have advantage.
glossary.unconscious: Incapacitated. Fails STR and DEX saves. Melee hits within 5 ft are critical.
glossary.hidden: Creatures don't know your location. Attacks automatically fail if they can't find you.
glossary.advantage: Roll 2d20 and use the highest result.
glossary.disadvantage: Roll 2d20 and use the lowest result.
glossary.concentration: When you take damage, succeed on a CON save (DC 10 or half damage). Failing breaks the spell.
glossary.ritual: You can cast this spell as a ritual (+10 minutes, no spell slot required).
glossary.critical hit: On a natural 20, roll the damage dice twice.
glossary.cover: Half cover: +2 AC and DEX saves. Three-quarters: +5. Full cover: cannot be targeted.
glossary.reaction: Special action usable once per round, even outside your turn.
glossary.bonus action: Additional action granted by class features or specific spells. One per turn.
glossary.finesse: You can use STR or DEX (whichever is higher) for attack and damage.
glossary.light: You can use this weapon in two-weapon fighting.
glossary.heavy: Small creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls.
glossary.versatile: You can wield it with two hands to use the damage die in parentheses.
glossary.reach: Adds 5 ft to your melee reach.
glossary.thrown: You can throw this weapon at range.
glossary.ammunition: Requires ammunition. You recover half after combat.
glossary.loading: Only one attack per action/bonus action/reaction, regardless of extra attacks.
glossary.opportunity attack: Reaction: when a visible creature leaves your reach without Disengaging.
glossary.disengage: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.
glossary.dash: You gain extra movement equal to your speed for the current turn.
glossary.dodge: Until your next turn, attack rolls against you have disadvantage (if you can see the attacker).
